summary: Cowlitz County DNR tower built 1959 and staffed until 1967; gone by 1970, with a lookout footing photographed on a 2017 visit.

access.note: State land; the route crosses Weyerhaeuser timberland through gates on an easement, per WillhiteWeb

visit.trail_note: Good gravel roads; expect gates along the Weyerhaeuser section of the route

facts.status_note: Gone by 1970; a lookout footing was photographed on a 2017 visit, and the summit is expected to have no view until the next harvest

notes_for_editor: Built 1959, staffed to 1967 and gone by 1970 agree across three sources. The DNR biennial report is quoted second-hand on the Washington Lookouts page; the original report was not located. The 2017 date for the footing photo rests on the 'Site Visit 2017' heading, not a dated caption. Search results also surfaced a different Signal Peak on the Yakama Reservation (TrailChick); it was not used. No usable new photo found.
